# Kayak Summary
A DRAFT/INCOMPLETE summary of types of kayaks available and their pluses and minuses. Quiver = a do-it-all, Swiss Army Knife boat. We compiled the pluses and minuses from long-term user feedback.

| KAYAK | TYPE | PLUS | MINUS |
|:------|:-----|:-----| :---- |
| **NDK** |
| Classic | quiver | all round great boat, durable | spartan cockpit   |
| Expedition | tour | works in all conditions & expeditions   | long, cockpit   |
| Latitude | tour | fast, handles rough conditions | not a beginner boat |
| Sport   | quiver | handles well in all conditions, tough | short cockpit |
| Surf   | quiver | best all-round boat on the planet? | spartan cockpit |
| **P&H** |
| Aries | play | exceptional surf & tiderace play | tracking |
| Cetus | tour | great for all conditions | long |
| Delphin | play | exceptional surf & tiderace play | difficult to roll, slow |
| Scorpio | tour | fast & tracks very well | long = weathercocking |
| Valkyrie | tour | fast & can surf downwind | rudder, long = weathercocking |
| Virgo | play | excellent surf & rough water boat | slow |
| Volan | quiver | all rounder | pedestrian |
| **Rockpool** |  
| Taran   | speed | very fast | not a beginner boat, long |
| **Epic**   |   
| V8-10   | speed | fast  | open cockpit, not for spicy waters |
| **Tiderace** |
| Xceed   | quiver | does everything well | long |
| **Dagger** |
| Stratos   | play | great plastic boat for surf & play, low price | slow |
